scene: At a roaring, rocky river rapid on the open Ukrainian steppe, Asmund, huge and expressive in the foreground (lean young man, fair hair tied back, short fair beard, cream round face, rust-orange tunic, grey cloak, small bronze scale case at his belt, black mitten hands), staggers wide-eyed and exhausted under the front end of a long wooden dugout boat carried on the shoulders of a line of soaked crewmen; a live chicken perches smugly on the hull, white water foams on the right, and on a distant grassy ridge three tiny riders on horseback watch. Visible hardship: the boat out of the water, the weight, the danger on the horizon.

Before a huge stone city gate of Constantinople with domes and towers behind, Asmund, huge and expressive in the foreground (fair hair tied back, short fair beard, rust-orange tunic, grey cloak, bronze scale case), stands in a long queue of tired unarmed northern traders with bundles of furs, holding out his empty hands with a sheepish, nervous grin, while a stern Byzantine clerk in a long blue robe writes his name on a wax tablet and a guard points at a pile of confiscated axes. Visible hardship: the long voyage ends in paperwork.
